page.overview:
Who is Gig?

Gig is an obese man sporting liberty spikes and a crooked smile. He wears a pearl necklace and a leather jacket.

Not much is known about Gig's personality yet.

Gig appears to be a powerful hand-to-hand fighter.

Gig was one of the Kid Pirates fighting Kaidou's forces on the fourth floor of his castle, after Who's-Who's defeat.
